scope: Same-server diagnostic of cached native readiness/options versus an uncached native roller catalog query. Neither is a whole-mod/ForkPatch performance baseline.
instrumentation: System.nanoTime, currentThreadCpuTime and com.sun.management.ThreadMXBean thread allocation counters; alternating measurement order.
correctness: Repeated checks retain paid progress, energy counters, option-list identity, native matrix version and cached LU validity.
limitations: Cached path includes actual readiness plus options access; uncached path only recalculates the same material catalog. These are different scopes, reported explicitly.
Single process/environment; JIT, timer/instrumentation noise and scheduling affect measurements. Timing/allocation values are observations, not test thresholds.
Does not establish overall tick/frame/loaded-world performance, GPU behavior or a comparison against both original repositories.
